rv.q: The refreshing new show 'Amazing Grace' admirably covers slavery, abolition, sedition and spiritual themes in 1740s England and Africa, complete with spirited acting and inspirational ballads and anthems.
What makes 'Amazing Grace' work is that it tells a coherent story about genuine redemption that is neither sentimental nor preachy.
